prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. A scientist wants to show how temperature changes every hour during one day. Enter the most suitable code only.

content.text: Think about what the reader needs to follow as the hours go by.
The readings are one quantity taken in time order. Ask what the reader needs to see from one hour to the next, then pick the display made for that.
